full_prompt_en: A square studio fashion photograph shows a young male model in three-quarter profile against a plain light-gray backdrop. He looks to the right with a serious expression, his blue eyes visible beneath a close-fitting peaked cap. The cap is wrapped in dense graphic pattern: yellow bands, orange circles, violet swirls, black linework, and fragments resembling decorative lettering. Matching outerwear rises around his neck in a thick dark-purple collar, while the visible shoulders and straps are covered in bright yellow, orange, red, and gray ornamental printing. Long orange cords and ringed hardware hang at the side of the cap and jacket. Small flecks of yellow and violet pigment mark his cheek, nose, and brow, visually linking the skin to the garment colors. The composition crops closely at the chest and top of the cap, giving the intricate textile surfaces nearly as much attention as the face. Light is soft and even, with gentle shading along the nose and under the brim rather than a dramatic cast shadow. The gray background remains smooth and featureless, isolating every patterned edge. Fabric surfaces show stitches, ribbing, and layered folds beneath the print; the face is photographic and cleanly modeled. Yellow is the dominant bright field, supported by hot orange and violet accents and a few dark graphite areas. No readable slogan is required from the broken letter-like marks. The whole image feels playful and intentionally excessive, using a neutral studio setting to make the dense graphic costume and restrained gaze stand in sharp contrast.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形棚拍时装照片在素净浅灰背景前，以四分之三侧面展示一名年轻男性模特。他严肃地望向右方，蓝眼睛从贴合头部的有帽檐帽下可见。帽上覆盖密集图形花纹：黄色条带、橙色圆圈、紫色卷纹、黑线和像装饰字母的碎片。配套外衣在颈部升起厚实深紫领子，可见的肩与背带布满明黄、橙、红和灰色装饰印花。橙色长绳与环形金属件从帽侧和夹克垂下。细小黄色与紫色颜料点落在面颊、鼻和眉上，让皮肤与服饰颜色连成一体。构图贴近裁到胸口和帽顶，让繁细纺织表面几乎与脸同样受关注。光柔和均匀，鼻侧和帽檐下有轻阴影，而非戏剧性投影。灰背景平滑且没有任何景物，把每个花纹边缘隔离出来。织物表面在印花下仍可见缝线、罗纹与层叠褶皱；脸保持摄影感和清晰塑形。黄色是主导亮色场，热橙与紫色点缀辅助，另有少量深石墨区域。不要求从破碎的类字母痕迹读出完整标语。整幅图玩味且刻意过量，以中性棚拍环境让密集图形服装与克制目光形成鲜明对照。
style_prompt_en: Graphic studio photography sets densely printed, layered surfaces against a seamless neutral gray field. Yellow occupies the largest bright area, with orange, violet, red, and charcoal details repeating in bands, circles, swirls, pseudo-letter fragments, and small metallic glints. Close cropping makes fine seams, ribs, folds, and print registration visible. Soft even light reveals material relief and keeps shadow under protruding edges gentle. The eye alternates between a calm cleanly modeled central plane and the busy patterned border around it. Color feels intentionally excessive, but the blank backdrop and strong value separation prevent the composition from dissolving into noise.
style_prompt_zh: 图形化棚拍摄影把密集印花、层叠表面放在无缝中性灰场前。黄色占最大亮色面积，橙、紫、红与炭灰细节以条带、圆圈、卷纹、类字母碎片和小金属反光重复。贴近裁切使细缝、罗纹、褶皱和印花套准痕可见。柔和均匀的光显露材质起伏，凸起边缘下阴影轻浅。目光在安静清楚塑形的中央平面与周围繁忙花纹边界间往返。颜色有意过量，但空白背景和强明度分离防止构图化成噪声。
theme_en: A young model in densely patterned yellow streetwear and a matching cap
theme_zh: 一名年轻模特穿着密纹黄色街头服饰和配套帽子
name: Jeremy Scott
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
